gen-gf-baumans-gf-kosugi-maru: Baumans hits like a neon sign, every stroke the same tube and its c flung open like a wrench. Kosugi Maru follows in a glowing single line with stroke ends set far apart, so a long page of sans text feels light and unhurried.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-kumbh-sans: Professional through and through, Baumans commands the top line. Kumbh Sans, a plain sans with terminals cut well short of the bowl, would look timid if the heading were made small, and Baumans loses its swagger.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-lato: Bent tubing, bold intent. Baumans draws its whole alphabet as one length of line, while Lato's wide s curves, barely curled in, keep a long run of sans-serif text clean and easy going.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-libre-franklin: Baumans bends its curves to match its stems exactly, with a c opened wide like a wrench. Its edge against Libre Franklin's splayed terminal is the distinctive part.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-livvic: Livvic reads friendly and open, with no stress in its curves and a generous c. Baumans takes the commanding role above it, its wrench-shaped c and single-thickness strokes giving the pair real distinction.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-lunasima: Tube-lit and sharp, Baumans runs one track width like a neon sign. Lunasima then keeps a sans-serif body tidy, its c tips never creeping toward touching, so one font shouts and the other simply reads.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: LXGW Marker Gothic reads neutral and contemporary, with a bracelet-wide c and a lightly swelling stroke in each round letter. Baumans, a wire-like line gliding under the eye, supplies the distinctive edge.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-m-plus-1: That crescent-wrench c gives Baumans away, a commanding display face drawn at one thickness throughout. It delivers the punch, while M PLUS 1 handles the reading with big open eyes on every e and a.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-m-plus-1p: Commanding is how Baumans lands, one stroke width running through the whole alphabet. M PLUS 1p follows as a plain sans, its curve ends open everywhere, and the two split the job cleanly.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-m-plus-2: Wrench-wide c, tube-like strokes: Baumans looks built, not drawn. But shrink the heading and that commanding presence fades, while M PLUS 2, a plain sans with a gaping c, stays approachable at any size.
